items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: he had Eddie Durham in his band, his brother Bus Morton was in the band

ctx.x: Morton had a hell of a band. His records, 'Morton Swing' and --
Oh, yeah, right, right, all of that, yeah. Look, he had Hot Lips Page in his band, he had Eddie Durham in his band, his brother Bus Morton was in the band, he was a conductor for the band.
